thought: Hu Delin is defined by his 'Revolutionary Optimism' and youth. To distinguish him from the rugged veteran Ge Zhenlin, the stern leader Ma Baoyu, and the disciplined Song Xueyi, I need to visually code his youth and optimistic nature without relying solely on a smile (as per instructions to avoid relying on expression alone). I will assign him a specific physical trait: a rounder, fresher face compared to the gaunt starvation of others, and a specific way of wearing his uniform—his cap tilted slightly back to reveal his forehead, suggesting a more open, spirited personality. The prop will be a standard rifle, but the 'tilted cap' and 'youthful vitality' will be the visual anchor.
distinctive_features: Round, youthful face with a faded army cap tilted slightly back to reveal the forehead.
prompt: Art Direction: Cinematic historical portrait, full body shot. Subject: Hu Delin, a young Eighth Route Army soldier (1941 era). Core Action: Standing with a relaxed but resilient posture, holding an old Hanyang rifle upright with one hand. Distinctive Feature: He features a round, youthful face with a faded blue-grey army cap tilted slightly back, revealing a smooth, boyish forehead, distinguishing him from the older veterans. Outfit: Wears a dust-covered, patch-mended light blue-grey uniform tunic, fabric belt with ammunition pouches, puttees wrapped around lower legs, and black cloth shoes. Background: High contrast, solid dark slate-grey background to isolate the figure. Lighting: Dramatic chiaroscuro with a strong, warm rim light outlining his profile to symbolize hope, contrasting with the dark background. Atmosphere: Heroic, spirited, and historically gritty. Medium: Hyper-realistic film photography, 85mm portrait lens, deep focus on the subject.
ref_description: The young soldier with a round face and a tilted army cap.
